objective: Define proposed ISMS scope, constraints and a readiness roadmap.

prepare-readiness-roadmap.expected_when: An explicit project_root is supplied and the routine is due.
prepare-readiness-roadmap.acceptance: Produces working/isms-readiness-plan.md from provided evidence and states blockers and limitations.
prepare-readiness-roadmap.fallback: Write a blocker artifact; never infer missing evidence.
prepare-readiness-roadmap.recovery: Re-read current project inputs and continue within this eligible run.
